title: Sunset Sail Cruise in Key West
includes: Coolers of ice with cups and bottled water
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
There is no wheelchair ramp but we will do out best to accommodate wheelchair passengers.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Sailing on the Rover is an exciting, traditional sailing experience with a Hint of Piracy! Yes - We have cannons! Come sail on Key West's most photographed ship! The Schooner Jolly II Rover is the only squared rigged, topsail schooner in the Historic Seaport! It is Key West's famous "Red Sails in the Sunset" Tall Ship! There is no band playing or loud music. We go sailing! Plenty of room to get up and mingle with other guests. Help raise the sails! Steer the ship! Shoot the cannons! Or just sit back and relax!
